in_arabic.name: Fila
in_arabic.long_meaning: Fila هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. The name Fila is derived from the Arabic root 'f-l-a'. It refers to moonlight, the gentle and calming light of the moon. In Islamic tradition, the moon is a symbol of tranquility and peace. The name Fila is often given to girls to reflect these qualities and to invoke the blessings of Allah.
